what: Every release of startups.sgit.ai, narrated, oldest first. The newest row must be the version in admin/build/version.txt; build.py refuses otherwise.

releases.what: The first release, built from Dinis's voice memo of 20 October 2026 (the AI startup finder concept) and the guidance on sgit.ai for every repository in the estate. The site takes over the startups section of sgit.ai (build on vaults, and the eight business plans) and adds the finder: the interview that helps a person find their startup, as data (finder.json: seven stages, twenty-four questions, twelve signals, six routes, eight rules, first match wins), as a prompt to paste into Claude or ChatGPT, as a page that walks the stages in the browser and writes the record (nothing sent anywhere), and as the record template. The brief is published verbatim with the initial prompt; the first co-written article says what the finder is in Dinis's words and briefs the roles; three decisions are recorded from the memo; four roles (journalist, interviewer, librarian, engineer) with their first issues; the reality file and the corrections file; the review folder's intent layers from the brief and a derived file list; the gate (validate.js, twelve checks) and the release script; the five themes and the pipeline of the sibling sites. What does not exist yet is on the reality page.
